name: CSN 7353 危险品卸载 浓雾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 353, a flight from Wuhan to Los Angeles, the cargo manifest shows that there is dangerous goods on board, report it to company operations and request offload the luggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 353，从武汉飞往洛杉矶，货物舱单显示机上有危险品，向公司运行报告并请求卸下行李。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, CSN7353, the cargo manifest shows that there is dangerous goods on board, request offload the luggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，CSN7353，货物舱单显示机上有危险品，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 23, you have got the information November, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 23 号登机口，已收到通播 November，向武汉放行请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN7353, gate 23, information N, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN7353，23 号登机口，通播 N，请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36 right, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 Delta departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 Delta 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO 01D departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8900 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，LKO 01D 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8900 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, expect 15 minutes delay, the airport is temporarily closed due heavy fog, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，预计延误 15 分钟，机场因大雾临时关闭，稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, after traffic taxing behind is clear, push back and start up approved, pushed back onto taxiway Zulu 4, abeam gate 232, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，后方滑行飞机脱离后，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Zulu 4，正对 232 号登机口，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: After traffic taxing behind is clear, push back and start up approved, pushed back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 232, facing east, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 后方滑行飞机脱离后，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 232 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, you are unable to taxi, tell the controller that you will hold at present position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，由于大雾能见度变差，你无法滑行，告诉管制员你将在当前位置等待，直到能见度好转。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN7353, the visibility is getting worse due to heavy fog, we are unable to taxi, request hold at present position until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN7353，由于大雾能见度变差，我们无法滑行，请求在当前位置等待，直到能见度好转。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, the visibility is improving, continue taxi to holding point runway 36 right via taxiway Alpha 3 and Alpha.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，能见度正在好转，继续经滑行道 Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway A3 and A, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 353, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
B: Now you are at holding point runway 36 right, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN7353, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN7353，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 353, runway 36 right, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，跑道 36R，可以起飞，离地后联系 119.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact 119.7, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以起飞，离地后联系 119.7，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 1200 meters, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN7353, airborne, passing 1200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CSN7353，已离地，通过 1200 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 353, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，武汉离场，雷达识别，以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大爬升率爬升至 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters at 3000 feet per minute or greater, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟 3000 英尺或更大爬升率爬升至 3900 米，CSN7353。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 353, continue climb to 8900 meters, report passing 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 353，继续爬升至 8900 米，报告通过 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 8900 meters, report passing 6000 meters, CSN7353.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 8900 米，报告通过 6000 米，CSN7353。
